features.description: Demonstrate that a minimal infra plan can validate, lock, and close without dispatch.
steps: Validate this plan directory against the bundled agent-conventions schemas.
Run dontpanic plan lock against a temporary copy of this plan.
Run dontpanic plan close against the same temporary copy.
features.acceptance: The plan validates, plan lock flips status from draft to active, and plan close flips status from active to completed without dispatching an agent.
